in_sanskrit.name: Maran
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Death
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Maran एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Maran represents the god of death. He is the one who ends all life and takes the soul to the next world. Maran is a powerful and feared deity, symbolizing the inevitability of death and the cycle of life and rebirth.

in_hindi.name: मरान
in_hindi.long_meaning: Maut ka naam hai, jiske andar mamta hai, jiske wajah se maut aati hai. (Death is the name of that which has love within it, because of which death comes.)

in_marathi.name: Maran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Maran represents the god of death. He is the one who ends all life and takes the soul to the next world. Maran is a powerful and feared deity, symbolizing the inevitability of death and the cycle of life and rebirth.
